About Us — Bellhaven Senior Living Bellhaven Senior Living Home Our Communities About Us About Bellhaven Founded in 2003, Bellhaven Senior Living operates communities across Ohio, Michigan, Indiana, and Pennsylvania. In 2025 we welcomed the Harborview Care Group family of communities, and in 2026 we expanded further with select communities joining us from Cedar Trail. We believe every resident deserves dignity, connection, and outstanding care. © 2026 Bellhaven Senior Living. All rights reserved. · Corporate Office: 400 Bellhaven Way, Columbus, OH
